scope: All57 original entities: explicit historical Korean wing-unlock text, exact token relations, and ordinary-match generation evidence limits.

localSources.use: Historical exact CardID/dbfId and Korean HOW_TO_EARN tags for all45 collectible originals. Data preload alone does not establish live availability.
Pinned original scope and explicit native tag1452 relationships.

sources.use: Official Korean notice explicitly gives August12 adventure start, distinct from August10 client preload.
Official prologue notice identifies Enchanted Raven and Firelands Portal as rewards.
Class-challenge decks may contain cards not yet collectible. This is PvE and excluded.
Later 2020 forum discussion makes and immediately disputes Karazhan pre-wing generation claim; not adequate date evidence.
KAR_025b dbfId 39198 and Kara Kazham related card. Displayed release date Oct 22 2020 is erroneous for original release and rejected.
KAR_025 dbfId 39197, token-summoning text and Warlock class-challenge source.

sources.supports: Contemporaneous Korean report that prologue and first wing opened on August12.
Contemporaneous Korean Opera opening report; opening August19.
Contemporaneous Korean Menagerie opening report; opening August26.
Contemporaneous Spire opening report September2. Its retrospective August13 first-wing statement conflicts with official August12 and is not adopted.

conclusions: No reliable contemporaneous evidence was found to backdate a later-wing card to preload or an earlier wing through normal generation. This is not proof that earlier generation was impossible.
Do not use cards appearing in class-challenge premade decks or adventure bosses as ordinary-match evidence.

Class-challenge completion is a player ownership gate. Normal generation after that global wing unlock can precede an individual player completing the challenge, without moving the global calendar date.
KAR_030 is the noncollectible Cellar Spider; KAR_030a is the collectible Pantry Spider. Prefix/suffix heuristics would reverse them.
KAR_010a Whelp and KAR_097t Atiesh must not inherit dates of identically named classic/PvE entities. Only exact IDs are in scope.
No enchantment entries are in this catalog; do not add unrelated KAR enchantments merely by prefix.
